sentences.text: P.S. Case No. 43/2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 328/2021 under Sections 120B/420/406/379/34 IPC

. 
Heard Mr. P. Borthakur, learned Addl. P.P. for State.
It is submitted that Case Diary is forwarded by the IO but the IO has not forwarded the afore-mentioned report.

It is submitted by the learned Addl. P.P. that no report has been sent by the IO if the goods in the truck have been verified with the documents submitted by the petitioner before the IO and whether the goods and the vehicle is required for further investigation.

It is submitted by the learned Addl.
P.P.
that the IO has informed him that the owner has not appeared before the IO with the required documents for verification.
The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the documents marked as Annexure-8 and 9 clearly reveal that the petitioner was not illegally transporting the goods.
The petitioner has appeared before the IO with the documents but the IO has denied to verify the documents.
A report is called from the IO positively on the next date fixed if the goods along with the vehicle are required for further investigation.
